summary.intent: Run the GSD discuss-phase and plan-phase workflows end-to-end for Phase 65 ('SDK Write-Chain, Bin Re-link, and Invite Claim') of CipherBox, producing locked implementation decisions in 65-CONTEXT.md and executable PLAN.md files for downstream agents.
summary.outcome: All GSD workflow artifacts committed to the feature branch: 65-CONTEXT.md, 65-DISCUSSION-LOG.md, 65-RESEARCH.md, 65-PATTERNS.md, 65-VALIDATION.md, and 7 PLAN.md files (waves 1–4) with 0 blockers from the plan-checker; two warnings fixed inline before session end.

repo: Phase 62 codec already fully implements the write-body surface (sealNode, unsealNode, encodeWriteBody, decodeWriteBody with role 0x04); Phase 65 calls the codec, never reimplements it.

sealChildWriteKey/unsealChildWriteKey (role 0x04) are entirely absent from packages/core/src/node/seal.ts — only the read equivalents (role 0x02) exist; these must be added as Plan 65-01 before any other wave-2+ work.
claimInviteReadKey is already fully implemented in packages/sdk-core/src/share/grant.ts:184; Phase 65 invite-claim work is service wiring only, not primitive work.
reWrapForRecipients is already removed from the SDK layer (Phase 63); only apps/web/src/services/share.service.ts:469 remains, which is a Phase 68 deletion target.
shared-write.ts is fully stubbed — every export throws 'not implemented — phase 65 (write-chain)'; it is the core Phase 65 implementation target.
BinEntry.nodeRef exists as a Node type (Phase 62), but originalFolderKeyEncrypted is already absent from the type and only appears in test fixtures at bin.test.ts:724 and 1063.

The 'delete addShareKeys/reWrapForRecipients/encryptedChildKeys' ROADMAP directive splits by layer: sdk-layer reWrapForRecipients gone (Phase 63), addShareKeys/encryptedChildKeys apps/api removal is Phase 66, apps/web reWrapForRecipients is Phase 68.

The GSD planner consistently creates a stray docs/plan-phase-{N} branch and switches the working tree to it instead of committing to the current feature branch; a ff-merge-and-delete recovery is required after every planner subagent run.
gsd-tools commit helper returns false-negative {committed: false, reason: 'commit_failed'} even when commits land successfully; always verify with git log rather than retrying.

code.finding: sealChildReadKey/unsealChildReadKey (role 0x02) is the verbatim copy template for the missing sealChildWriteKey/unsealChildWriteKey (role 0x04) — only the role byte changes.
Two PLACEHOLDER_WRITE_KEY sites (L550 and L594) pass new Uint8Array(32) to rotateOne/sealNode; Phase 65 Plan 05 removes both and wires the real writeKey from the write-body unseal (folds FLAG-63-U1).
nodeKeySource seam with 'Phase 65 derives from write-body' comments; this is where the real writeKey threads into the rotation engine.

rotateOne structure is the structural template for the write-revocation driver (rotateWriteFromNode); the lines 641–651 catch block is the canonical zeroization template (zero minted keys only, never caller-supplied buffers).
GrantRemintCallbacks type is the copy pattern for WriteRevocationCallbacks needed in Plan 65-06.
insertShareFn injection pattern used by claimInviteReadKey; Plan 65-03 wraps claimInviteReadKey in a service function using this exact pattern.
permanentDeleteFromBin is the exact pattern for how addToBin/restoreFromBin should manipulate bin metadata and call saveBinMetadata.
addShareKeys endpoint — Phase 66 deletion target, not Phase 65; confirmed by grep.
reWrapForRecipients — Phase 68 deletion target; the only remaining copy after Phase 63 removed the SDK layer version.

workflow: AskUserQuestion must not be skipped after a command interrupt/re-invocation; a rejected question does not signal a preference for plain text — re-issue the structured question UI.
Plan-checker warnings with exact fix-hints can be resolved inline surgically without spawning a full planner revision cycle, saving significant tokens.
VALIDATION.md must be explicitly scaffolded by the orchestrator (not the researcher) whenever RESEARCH.md contains a 'Validation Architecture' section (Nyquist enabled).
PATTERNS.md must be committed explicitly by the orchestrator — the plan-phase workflow never auto-commits it.
After a planner subagent run, the standard recovery sequence is: git checkout feat/..., git merge --ff-only docs/plan-phase-N, git branch -d docs/plan-phase-N.

friction: AskUserQuestion was silently skipped after the first command interrupt, requiring user to explicitly ask 'why are the questions being skipped?' before the structured UI was restored.
gsd-tools commit helper returned false-negative commit_failed on every commit (×3 in this session), requiring git log verification after each one — adds friction to every planning session.
GSD planner switches the working tree to a stray docs/plan-phase-{N} branch instead of committing to the feature branch, requiring a manual ff-merge recovery step every time.
